snippet.title: Famine - Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
A terrible curse has fallen. The entire world suffer from famine. To survive, humanity has been forced to take part in a deadly card game called "The ritual."

Famine is a horror roguelike deckbuilder. Each day, you embody a new candidate for the Ritual. If you succeed, you keep humanity from dying for a few more days. If you fail, you die.



You can play here : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4780950

Discord : https://discord.gg/UvcmNPxjg

Twitter : https://x.com/fbr_game
